entries.text: TPC-Havoc `1_v7` on Presto, Trino, Athena, BigQuery, Spark and Databricks is translated from its DuckDB text with the fork's `order_list_aggregates` (ordered by `l_orderkey, l_linenumber`) and `reduce_list_aggregates` rewrites; the BenchBox AST rewriter for the array aggregation is removed and `translate_sql_query` accepts a `dialect` entry in a rewrite's arguments to run that rewrite under the target dialect. Presto, Trino and Athena now reduce the arrays with `REDUCE`/`ZIP_WITH` instead of `UNNEST`; BigQuery reduces them with `GENERATE_ARRAY` subqueries; Databricks uses the fork's `SORT_ARRAY` collect and `AGGREGATE`; Spark, which previously received untranslated `LIST` calls, now gets the same text as Databricks. Identifiers are no longer quoted. On Trino 476, PrestoDB 0.298.1 and PySpark 4.2.0 at TPC-H tiny scale the new text returns the DuckDB rows (relative tolerance 1e-9); Athena runs the same text and was not available. BigQuery has no emulator and stays skipped. No published bundle holds a `1_v7` row for these engines; the DuckDB bundles are unchanged. Read Primitives output is unchanged on all 21 dialects.
